Chatter

Chatter enables chat communication with your site's visitors , either registered users or anonymous.

Project Overview

Chatter is a SaaS application that is specifically designed to help businesses manage their interactions with customers through messaging. It offers features such as group chat, direct messaging, and the ability to share files and other content.

My Roles
  • Conducting user research to understand how businesses and customers use chat for communication.
  • Planned and organized project tasks into sprints to efficiently break down and complete the project.
  • I also worked closely with developers to ensure that the chat features are implemented according to the design specifications and function as intended.
  • Additionally, I was also involved in defining and enforcing design standards and guidelines for the overall CRM application.

Chatter is a customer relationship management, is a platform that helps businesses manage and track their customer interactions, sales, and support. It typically provides tools for managing customer information, such as contact details and purchase history, and for automating and tracking sales and support activities. Web-based CRMs often integrate with other business systems and tools, such as email and messaging platforms, to provide a central hub for managing customer relationships. They may also offer features such as chat and messaging tools, as well as integrations with social media and other channels, to help businesses communicate with their customers in real-time and across multiple channels.

The project was divided into four phases:

  • Support
  • Marketing
  • Sales
  • Management and operation

Sitemap and flow
Final Screens

Login

A simple sign up page that allow users to either log in using Google, Apple and Linkedin.

Channels

Integrating channels allows users to access and interact with the application through a variety of platforms such as social media, messaging apps, or other third-party tools.

Boards

Boards allow users to organize and track tasks and projects by creating a visual representation of the work that needs to be done. Boards are used to track the progress of individual tasks or projects, assign tasks to team members, set deadlines, and collaborate with others. It also offers features such as comments, attachments, and integration with other tools and platforms.

Billing

We have subscription-based billing where customers pay a recurring fee on a regular basis, monthly or annually and access your service. This model can be further customized with different pricing tiers or plans, allowing customers to choose the level of service that best meets their needs.

Chat widget

This allows users to communicate with a support team in real time. These widgets are customized in various colors in order to differentiate between the type of users.

Takeaways

Keeping it simple: The simpler the design, the easier it is for users to navigate and accomplish tasks. One should avoid cluttered interfaces, excessive features, or confusing terminology.

Responsive design: The application should be responsive across various devices, screen sizes, and browsers. This way, users can access the application from anywhere, at any time.

Creating a seamless user experience: Ensuring that the application has a consistent look and feel, and that users can move through the application with ease.

Next Steps

The next step would be to collaborate with the development team to develop, deploy test and launch. After launching, we need to ensure that it provides value to users and meets their needs.
